integrity: Proof is analytic with an exact finite remainder; finite checks are supporting only. No claim of external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-dimensional reciprocal-distance path matrix; no certified decimal for Lambda, convergence rate, or general graph extension. Continuum spectral simplicity is prior literature. Possible stronger historical Toeplitz/Harary coverage unresolved.
title: A logarithmic-Laplacian spectral limit for critical discrete HLS path matrices
